candidates.from: Texas Gas Transmission 26-inch line, Jefferson County, Kentucky

evidence.note: A 2021 feed study for a pipeline of about 0.92 miles from the existing 26-inch Texas Gas line to the plant, with 12-inch and 16-inch cases and a new interconnect station.
July 2026 project update for the new Mill Creek 6 gas unit. It says data center demand drives the need, with about 11.6 GW of data center prospects.

candidates.why_maybe_new: A short lateral from the Texas Gas main line to a plant built for data center load. The study is the only source and no source says it was approved or built. It may be a short stub on the existing main line row.

seed_ledger.name: Mill Creek Station
seed_ledger.reason: NEW_LATERAL. Mill Creek 6 is a new gas combined-cycle unit approved in October 2025 and justified by data center load. A 2021 feed study describes a pipeline of about 0.92 miles from the Texas Gas 26-inch line, near the nearest existing route. No source confirms the line was approved or built, so it is queued as a short candidate with unconfirmed status. Searches run: 14. Sources checked: the Kentucky PSC July 2026 project update showed data center demand and no gas line detail; the 2021 feed study showed the 0.92 mile option; the utility press release showed the unit approval; the EIA pipeline list, Boardwalk filings and Louisville news showed no Mill Creek lateral; air permit documents mention only pipeline gas.
